title: Silence alarms with volume or power button press
symptom: User wants to silence/snooze xDrip+ alarms by pressing volume or power buttons, as when silencing an incoming phone call. They were caught in church with alarm going off and had to use Pebble snooze button.
cause: The thread does not establish a root cause for the issue; it is a feature request. The maintainer explains difficulties: volume change events are not easily available, and xDrip itself adjusts system volume based on alarm profile, causing self-triggering. Media button receiver not reliable.
fix: The maintainer implemented a partial fix: silencing the alarm by pressing volume buttons from the app home graph screen, available in the latest nightly release. No reliable way when phone is locked or outside the app.
evidence_quote: What I have been able to make work is silencing the alarm by pressing the volume buttons from the app home graph screen.. This isn't ideal but it does make it that bit easier to manage at 3am etc.
